title: Cendaña files counter-affidavit on libel, cyberlibel complaint filed by Quiboloy
summary: Akbayan Party List Rep. Percival Cendaña filed on Friday his counter-affidavit on the libel and cyber libel complaint filed against him by Kingdom of Jesus Christ leader Apollo Quiboloy.
